screens.title: Student workspace: Spark
screens.description: Student enters Quest and sees the baseline job before any downstream artifact.

layout.title: Spark | VERTEX 4D
layout.directionText: Spark Locked Baseline + ProjectRecord Next action Create a Spark case and lock the starting snapshot. Why it matters VERTEX needs the first belief state before it can show what changed. What VERTEX should reveal What the team believes before evidence, systems and economics push back. Where this goes Riddle, facilitator cohort view, Brief, Outcome Report Hard gate: without baseline, before/after evidence breaks.
visibleHeadings:
Open Spark.
Lock the first snapshot.

screens.title: Student workspace: Riddle
screens.description: Student frames the problem and sees why the ProblemFrame matters downstream.

layout.title: Riddle | VERTEX 4D
layout.directionText: Riddle ProblemFrame Next action Save a ProblemFrame. Why it matters The rest of the chain should not reason from a vague or solution-shaped problem. What VERTEX should reveal Whether the team is solving a real problem or describing a preferred solution. Where this goes Tangle, Gatekeeper, Stamp, Brief Soft gate: weak framing can continue, but the risk remains visible.
visibleHeadings:
Stress-test the problem.
Keep the useful discomfort.

screens.title: Student workspace: Tangle
screens.description: Student maps users, payers, approvers, blockers and dependencies.

layout.title: Tangle | VERTEX 4D
layout.directionText: Tangle SystemMap Next action Save a SystemMap with payer, approver, blocker and dependencies. Why it matters Adoption depends on more than the user; the decision lives in a stakeholder system. What VERTEX should reveal Who can make the decision work, approve it, pay for it, or block it. Where this goes Gatekeeper, Ripple, Ledger, facilitator intervention radar Soft gate: missing authority paths become intervention si
visibleHeadings:
Make the system visible.
Then name the dependencies.

screens.title: Student workspace: Gatekeeper
screens.description: Student/facilitator sees which assumptions can propagate into Ripple or Ledger.

layout.title: Gatekeeper | VERTEX 4D
layout.directionText: Gatekeeper Approved assumption register Next action Approve only assumptions that are allowed to feed Ripple or Ledger. Why it matters Unreviewed assumptions must not travel downstream disguised as facts. What VERTEX should reveal Which beliefs are evidence-backed, which are assumptions, and what still needs evidence. Where this goes PredictiveHypothesis, FinancialScenario, Stamp traceability Hard gate for downstream
visibleHeadings:
Choose which assumptions
can carry weight.

screens.title: Student workspace: Ripple + QBI lite
screens.description: Student creates a bounded behavior hypothesis and sees QBI lite as a reading, not a prediction.

layout.title: Ripple | VERTEX 4D
layout.directionText: Ripple PredictiveHypothesis + QBI lite reading Next action Create a PredictiveHypothesis and QBI lite reading. Why it matters The team needs to see adoption, resistance, undecided behavior and context-loss risk. What VERTEX should reveal Where stakeholder behavior may resist the plan, even when the idea looks attractive. Where this goes Stamp, Brief, facilitator decision intervention Bounded hypothesis: not evidence,
visibleHeadings:
Ya sabes quién está en el sistema.
Ahora, quién se resiste.
What may help or slow adoption
How conflicting interpretations move through the system

screens.title: Student workspace: Ledger
screens.description: Student tests economic assumptions and pricing coherence.

layout.title: Ledger | VERTEX 4D
layout.directionText: Ledger FinancialScenario Next action Create a FinancialScenario from explicit founder assumptions. Why it matters Before committing resources, check whether price, margin and cost structure can survive. What VERTEX should reveal Whether the current price intuition conflicts with variable cost, volume or runway. Where this goes Stamp, Brief, Outcome Report pricing movement Soft gate: weak numbers can continue, but rem
visibleHeadings:
Tu idea ya tiene sistema.
Ahora que hable el dinero.
What kind of business are we pricing?

screens.title: Student workspace: Stamp
screens.description: Student converts the reviewed chain into a bounded next commitment.

layout.title: Stamp | VERTEX 4D
layout.directionText: Stamp Stamp / DecisionRecord Next action Create and save a Stamp artifact. Why it matters The analysis must collapse into a bounded next commitment without hiding uncertainty. What VERTEX should reveal What changed from the baseline belief and what still remains uncertain. Where this goes Brief, facilitator review, Cohort Outcome Report Commit gate: hypotheses stay labelled; the final decision records provenance.
visibleHeadings:
La cadena está completa.
Ahora firma la decisión.
